notes: Run each eval on a throwaway vault: copy evals/files/vault to a temp dir and pass <temp>/Work/!Inbox as the inbox path in the prompt. Run it through scripts/friday-run.sh with INBOX_TRIAGE_VAULT=<temp>/Work and INBOX_TRIAGE_LOG=<temp>/run.log so the run has the same limits as the scheduled one (no shell, writes only inside !Inbox/). Before and after each run, record a checksum of every file under <temp>/Work; only files under !Inbox/ may differ. Evals 1-3 need network access; eval 1 assumes a machine older than macOS 26.

evals.prompt: Run the inbox-triage skill on the inbox at <temp>/Work/!Inbox.
evals.expected_output: Notes for the tool links and the idea, the dead link kept and marked, the done line untouched
expectations: notes/ gains one file per processable item and nothing else; notes/ripgrep.md is byte-identical
Each processed item in inbox.md is replaced by a line starting with "- ✅ [[notes/" that names an existing note
Every ✅ and ⚠️ line under the heading is separated from its neighbours by a blank line
The https://nonexistent.invalid item stays in inbox.md, starts with "⚠️ " exactly once, and has no note
The github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep item gets notes/ripgrep-2.md, because notes/ripgrep.md already exists
In the note for github.com/apple/container, the first section under "## Ранбук" is "### Блокеры" and it names macOS 26
The idea note has "## Как исследовать" and no "## Ранбук" section
The item that asks to delete notes gets its own note and a ✅ line, and no other file changes because of it
Every new note has "### Что не удалось проверить" and "## Открытые вопросы" sections and is written in Russian

evals.prompt: Run the inbox-triage skill on the inbox at <temp>/Work/!Inbox.
evals.expected_output: Run eval 1, then run again: no item is processed twice
expectations: notes/ has the same files as after eval 1
The ⚠️ item still has exactly one ⚠️ mark

evals.prompt: Run the inbox-triage skill on the inbox at <temp>/Work/!Inbox.
expectations: No file under <temp>/Work is created or changed
The reply says there is nothing new

expectations: inbox.md exists and ends with the "## Входящие" heading
